press_references.value: Forward Networks Introduces Forward AI to Accelerate Network Operations with Mathematical Certainty

product_launches.description: Forward Networks announced Forward AI, a new AI-driven capability within its Forward Enterprise platform that uses a mathematically accurate network digital twin to let IT, security, and cloud teams query, validate, and automate network operations.

overview_description.description: Forward Networks delivers an innovative platform that provides network visibility, policy verification, and change modeling. Designed to help network teams eliminate costly network outages, the Forward Networks platform enables engineers and operators to easily visualize and search complex networks, quickly debug problems, verify network-wide policy correctness, and predict network behavior prior to making changes to production equipment for legacy, SDN, or hybrid environments.
